title: Destiny 2
description: Now that live service is over for this game, I am working on "solo-flawless" activities, starting with dungeons. A solo flawless is completing an activity which is usually done with 3 people, solo - without dying once. Currently have finished "Prophecy" and "Grasp of Avarice".
